jobs.title: Data Platform Engineering II
jobs.description:
**Platform Engineer II – Data Platform Engineering**

  

**This is a hybrid role, 2 days on site in our Chicago office.**

**We are looking for local candidates in the Chicago area only.**

  

**About the Team**

The Data Platform team builds and maintains the organization's enterprise knowledge catalog, knowledge graph, and unified data pipelines. We provide reusable data pipeline tooling for the enterprise and manage the entire BigQuery and analytics ecosystem. We focus on data accessibility, semantic connectivity, and automation to improve how data is discovered, processed, and utilized across the company.

  

**The Role**

You will build AI data agents that interact with our enterprise knowledge catalog, knowledge graph, and extensive analytics infrastructure. This role is responsible for automating complex data workflows, contributing to intelligent data pipeline tooling, and building scalable integrations that bridge our AI capabilities with our core data platforms.

  

**What You’ll Get**

* A supportive environment fostering career progression, continuous learning, and an inclusive culture.
* Broad exposure to CME's diverse products, asset classes, and cross-functional teams.
A competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Explore our full range of benefits  

  

**What You’ll Do**

* **Agent Development:** Design, build, and deploy AI data agents to query and navigate the enterprise knowledge graph, data catalogs, and analytics systems.
* **Skill Creation:** Develop modular Agent Skills to execute data retrieval, transformation, and analytical tasks.
* **Agent Evaluation:** Design and implement Agent Evals to test the reliability, accuracy, and factual consistency of agent outputs.
* **Data Pipeline & Analytics Integration:** Build intelligent integrations and reusable tooling that interface with our unified data pipelines and BigQuery ecosystems.
* **Knowledge Integration:** Collaborate with data engineers to ingest, curate, and expand the enterprise knowledge catalog and knowledge graph.
* **Tool Utilization:** Leverage Coding Agent tools (Claude, Anti Gravity, and GitHub Copilot) to accelerate technical delivery and code generation.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Academic Foundation** of a Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline) accompanied by 2+ years of relevant hands-on engineering experience.
* **Programming Languages:** Strong proficiency in **Python** and **Java** .
* **AI Frameworks:** Hands-on experience building AI agents using **Google ADK** and **LangChain** .
* **Agent Tooling:** Direct experience developing Agent Skills and building **Agent Evals** .
* **AI Assistants:** Experience utilizing Coding Agent tools ( **Claude, Anti Gravity, GitHub Copilot** ) in the software development lifecycle.
* **Execution:** Ability to work proactively in a team environment and meet delivery timelines.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Data Systems:** Experience working with knowledge graphs, enterprise data catalogs, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
* **Primary Cloud & Analytics:** Hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and deep knowledge of **BigQuery** .
* **GitOps & Orchestration:** Experience with **GitOps** practices and deploying applications to **Kubernetes** .
* **Foundational Models:** Experience working with **Gemini models, Anthropic models,** or **GPT models** .
* **Multi-Cloud:** Experience with other major cloud providers ( **AWS** or **Azure** ).

CME Group is committed to offering a competitive total rewards package for our employees that recognizes their contributions to the business and reflects our long-term investment in their future. The pay range for this role is $93,900-$156,500. Actual salary offered will be dependent on a wide array of factors including but not limited to: relevant experience, skills, education and comparison to internal employees (where relevant). Our compensation program also includes an annual target bonus opportunity for all employees, as well as the opportunity to become an owner in the company through our broad-based equity program. Through our benefits program, we strive to offer flexibility, value and choice. From comprehensive health coverage, to a retirement package that includes both a 401(k) and an active pension plan, to highly competitive education reimbursement provisions, paid time off and a mental health benefit, CME Group offers a holistic benefits package for our team and their dependents.

**CME Group: Where Futures are Made**

CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.

At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job description:**

**Data Analyst Role Responsibilities**

* Collect, clean, validate, and analyze large datasets from multiple internal and external data sources.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support business operations and strategic decision-making.
* Analyze business performance, customer behavior, operational metrics, and product performance to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product managers, engineering teams, finance, marketing, and operations to translate business questions into data-driven insights.
* Design and execute ad hoc analyses to support business initiatives and executive decision-making.
* Create recurring reports and automate reporting processes to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze structured data from relational databases.
* Validate data accuracy, identify anomalies, and ensure consistency across reporting systems.
* Define, monitor, and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
* Build interactive dashboards using business intelligence tools to communicate insights effectively.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, correlations, and business opportunities.
* Support A/B testing, experimentation, and performance measurement initiatives.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to improve data pipelines, data models, and reporting infrastructure.
* Document business definitions, reporting logic, metric calculations, and analytical methodologies.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear visualizations and presentations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes using data and analytics.
* Ensure compliance with organizational data governance, security, and privacy standards.
* Stay current with emerging analytics tools, technologies, and industry best practices.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience as a data analyst or in a similar analytical role.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), aggregations, and query optimization.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and data analysis techniques.
* Hands-on experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Experience analyzing large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable business insights.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience writing complex analytical queries and developing automated reporting solutions.
* Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, automation, and statistical analysis.
* Experience with data cleaning, validation, profiling, and quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, trend analysis, and business performance measurement.
* Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
* Experience creating executive dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in Agile or cross-functional business environments.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in business analytics, data science, statistics, computer science, or a related discipline.
* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Databricks.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT processes and data integration tools.
* Familiarity with dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar data transformation and orchestration tools.
* Experience using cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and forecasting techniques.
* Experience supporting A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and causal analysis.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience working with APIs and integrating external data sources.
* Knowledge of version control systems such as Git.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Pandas, NumPy, or Jupyter Notebooks.
* Familiarity with machine learning concepts and model evaluation techniques.
* Experience working in SaaS, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, enterprise software, or high-growth technology organizations.
* Professional certifications in Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Azure Data, AWS Analytics, Google Cloud Data Analytics, or equivalent certifications.
* Demonstrated ability to influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Visa sponsorship

Work Location: In person

Pay: $84,196.43 - $90,237.04 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) 5% Match
* Dental insurance
* Flextime
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist I
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The Global Research, Informatics & Platform Solutions team within the Information Research (IR) Division works with internal clients to provide data management and decision support tools to optimize the efficiency and efficacy of research and development at AbbVie. Under leadership guidance, this role supports multiple areas within Research & Discovery to build visualizations, transform data, capture data, and support end users. The role also participates in data flow documentation and general requirement gathering. This is a cross-functional role, working directly with discovery scientists and technology stakeholders to optimize data capture, visualization, and decision-making.

**Responsibilities:**

* Communicate – Ability to communicate with scientific individuals. from Discovery teams to understand existing workflows and data flow & gather requirements.
* Build – Design and implement technology solutions that integrate, visualize, and analyze complex multi-platform data, including omics, biomarkers, & preclinical safety.
* Integrate – Understand the value in capturing data properly and integrating data sets.
* Support – Work directly with scientists to support their dashboarding or technical needs.
* Technical Proficiency – Demonstrate high proficiency in python, SQL, & other technologies for data storage, transfer, integration, visualization, and analytics.
* Adaptability – Ability to work on multiple, sometimes very different, projects at one time.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s Degree.
* Background in life sciences, biology, or equivalent required.
* Dedicated team player who can interface with discovery scientists and IT partners.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python (and possibly other modern languages) and strong familiarity with data visualization and pipelining tools such as Spotfire, or equivalent
* Understanding of software development process and familiarity with CI/CD tools.
* Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration & training, including documenting and presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders: outstanding interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Familiarity with modern data science and AI techniques & interest in further developing technical skills and scientific knowledge.
* Ability to work independently, multitask, and work within timelines.
* A self-motivated learner and thinker with a hands-on approach.

  
**Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst, Advanced Analytics
jobs.description:
The Quantitative Analyst in Regulatory Operations Analytics is responsible for the planning and execution of analytics projects throughout their lifecycle. This includes defining the approach, having the ability to scope and drive analytics with the appropriate quantitative methods, and working closely with the business to ensure project objectives and goals are met. This role works across the business to promote the use of advanced analytics to solve business problems.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Promote the use of advanced analytics and associated insights for the consumption of internal and external stakeholders, including senior level management across the organization.
* Leads business engagement activities including soliciting use cases, user feedback, training, etc.
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of FINRA’s cross-market surveillance program.
* Work across delivery teams to deliver analytics capabilities that solve critical business problems.
* Drive availability of relevant data, tools, and infrastructure to facilitate for experimental and development purposes.
* Provide analytics-based research and respond to ad hoc requests in support of business objectives.
* Define approach for data collection for building analytics-based systems, transformations and extending company’s data with third party sources of information when needed.
* Devise and implement methods for automation of all parts of the predictive pipeline to achieve regulatory efficiencies.
* Actively participate in the completion of the enterprise-wide strategic plan for expanding analytics capabilities that support regulatory programs to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

* Demonstration of FINRA’s values.
* Collaboration, both in-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity.

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Mentor other Research Analysts on the team and within FINRA on methodologies and best practices.
* Maintain essential skills by attending training programs, associated conferences, and continued education in advanced analytics, software development, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM, Business, or similar quantitative discipline, and six (6) or more years of related work experience in Data Science, Engineering or Software development; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in advanced analytics using machine learning, data mining, and natural language processing, preferred.
* Familiarity with Big Data processing and platforms desirable.
* Strong knowledge in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, R, SQL, or SCALA.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex and prolonged projects.

**Working Conditions:**

* Hybrid work environment, with defined in-person presence requirements. Occasional travel and extended hours may be required.
